name: yktori
method: Read-only public Kaggle profile and Competitions pages loaded once each in the app's built-in browser on 2026-10-30 (profile, then a five-second pause, then competitions). Text read from the rendered pages; each medal read from the medal icon next to the rank (icon alt text and a screenshot of the first rows); displayed handles read from the entry avatar tooltips; join date from the profile's join tooltip. No refresh loops, no block or rate limit encountered. No other site was visited. An older unverified draft did not exist in the worktree, so nothing was carried over.

portrait.note: The profile's picture is Kaggle's stock default goose sketch (the avatar element points at Kaggle's own default-avatar image, and every entry thumbnail for this account is the default thumbnail), not a picture the player chose. No other public picture of this player is cited by their record. No portrait file exists under news-images/people for this id and none was saved. The newspaper's Silver Comet helmeted mascot (references/2026-10-29-yktori-avatar-v1-base.webp) is a fictional stand-in made by the newsroom, explicitly not a likeness and not owner-selected, so it must not be shown or labelled as this player's own picture. As of this check, cards.json (read only, not edited) still uses that mascot as the art of the person card person-yktori-2026 (art note: not an owner-selected avatar or a human likeness) and of the team card team-yktori-team-2026, so the person card currently shows a stand-in and needs the Boss's decision on a replacement or a no-picture treatment.

teamNotes: Kaggle's profile list shows displayed handles, not team names, so no team name is recorded for any entry; every teamName is null rather than guessed.

Eighteen of the twenty completed entries show only yktori. Mechanisms of Action (kuroironeko, yktori, yuishizaki) and M5 Forecasting - Accuracy (kuroironeko, kfkabdg, wat516, yktori, yuishizaki) show several accounts, matching the profile's two competitions in a team.
The Mechanisms of Action bronze is a team medal and must not be credited to yktori alone; the other four medals are on entries displaying only yktori.
The ARC-AGI-3 team on the ARC-3 public roster is recorded in people.json as team yktori; that standing was not rechecked in this pass and any rank from it is provisional.
